Gleuhr Guide — Counsellor (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the counsellor's module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval before it
is built into the app. It covers the counsellor's desk: the sale, the visit close, follow-up calls,
balances and money on file.
What is in it: 47 How do I…? cards, 14 rules, 11 lessons with 33 check questions, and 5
sign-off tasks.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or the old manual.
Screenshots: made-up data only. Four are placed. The others are shown as
[Screenshot to add …] lines until they are rendered.
Numbers: every limit in Part 4 is a clinic setting. They were read on the test copy; the
lane confirms them on production.
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for. You are the clinic's commercial desk. The doctor writes the clinical
plan. You turn that plan into what the patient buys, close every visit, and keep a next step
alive for every patient. The clinic lives on repeat visits and on instalments, so the follow-up
is half of your job.
What you decide.
The price, the package, and how the payment is spread over visits (the payment plan).
How a visit closes, and the next follow-up date.
Whether a patient's journey is over (a hard-close). Only a counsellor can do this.
Applying money already on file (an advance, store credit or a token) to a payment.
What you never decide.
Which treatments she needs, and how many — that is the doctor's call.
Taking the cash, card or UPI — reception collects and gives the receipt. Nothing you
build exists until reception collects.
Approving your own changes — a booking move for someone else's patient goes to the
branch manager (BM); a change to a package's amount goes to the Sales Head.
Gleuhr Guide — Counsellor (draft)

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.text:
Editing money history. A wrong figure is corrected by a new entry, never by changing
the old one.
Who hands to you, and who you hand to.
Reception checks the patient in → she appears on your Today.
The doctor saves the consult and presses send → the plan is on your Build page.
You send the build → reception's Awaiting payments → reception collects → the
package is created.
A first-consult patient who buys no treatment → the BM is told (the close gate asks
you).
A visit with treatment today → after your close, the doctor signs off the session and
the therapist treats; the doctor closes the visit after the treatment.
Money questions after the fact → the accounts desk (you see their answers in Decided
claims).
Your day.
1 . Open Today. See who is checked in, who is waiting at reception, who owes money.
2. Morning Huddle — for each cross-sell patient, decide who pitches.
3. Through the day: build, send to reception, close each visit the same day.
4. Between patients: work Follow-ups — every call ends with a next date or a hard-close.
5. Evening: Close my day. It refuses while a visit is unclosed or a call due today is not
done.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them. Know them
anyway, so a refusal never surprises you.
This desk OWNS This desk NEVER decides
The price, the package and the payment
plan
Which treatments she needs, and how many
(the doctor)
How each visit closes, and the next
follow-up
Taking the cash, card or UPI (reception)
Applying money on file to a payment Approving your own changes (the BM or the
Sales Head)
Ending a patient's journey (hard-close) Verifying a hand-recorded payment (the
accounts desk)

blocks.title: Page 3
blocks.text:
The rule Why
The doctor decides the treatments and how
many sessions. You build the sale from her
plan.
Clinical and commercial decisions are kept
apart.
Nothing you build exists until reception
collects. The package and its plan are
created at that moment.
Money owed must match money taken.
The first payment must be at least the
clinic's first-visit share of the package (10%
today, a setting).
Every package starts with a real
commitment.
Money on file (an advance, store credit or a
token) is spent only when you apply it, and
never beyond what is left. A part-used
advance keeps the rest. Closing a visit never
spends it.
Money on file is never overspent or spent by
accident.
Money history is never edited. A wrong
figure is corrected by a new entry; the old
one stays visible.
Nothing is silently overwritten.
Every visit closes only through Close visit ✓,
and every close needs a next step.
No patient leaves without a next step.
Every call ends with a next date or a hard-
close.
A follow-up never just disappears.
Three no-answers in a row move a follow-up
to Unreachable. Any real contact resets the
count.
A person decides what happens next, not a
loop.
Only a counsellor hard-closes a patient —
never the doctor, never the BM.
The person who owns the relationship ends
it.
Balance follow-ups are created and chased
automatically. "Paid" is not a button: they
close when the money is recorded.
Money owed never depends on memory.
You never approve your own change. A
package amount change goes to the Sales
Head; moving someone else's patient's
booking goes to the BM.
The person who checks is not the person
who asks.
Gleuhr Guide — Counsellor (draft)

3 · Processes
My pages
The menu is in groups. At the top of the screen there is a search box, Add appointment,
Product sale, and the ? menu (How to use, Report a bug).
Dashboard — your own scorecard for a day, week, month or a range of dates. Read only.
Sales — every payment credited to you, one line per payment, with tiles by kind of sale.
Read only.
Today group
Today — today's visits that are yours or have no counsellor. Tabs: Checked in · Closed ·
Today's appointments · Unclosed (incl. unassigned). Each open row has Build (a new
patient) or Open (everyone else). A closed visit of today has Add a sale. Above the table:
Waiting at reception — to check in.
Morning Huddle — today's (or tomorrow's) patients. Lists: Balance-Pending · Cross-sell ·
At-risk. Your target for the day is at the top (My today's target, Planned).
Follow-ups — your call list. On Today's list there are three lists: Follow-up calls, Pending
balance calls, Visit confirmations. Other views: Tomorrow · Overdue · Unreachable · All
follow-ups · Done today.
Tickets — To me · From me · To confirm. Raise, acknowledge, resolve and confirm tickets.
Close my day — the list of what is still open on your day. You close your day here.
Patients group
Patients — the clinic's patient book. Search by name, phone or number. + Add patient.
The rule Why
A payment-link payment is verified by the
payment gateway by itself. A payment you
record by hand goes to the accounts desk to
verify.
Money taken outside the desk always has a
second pair of eyes.
A new patient who leaves without buying a
treatment (consult-only, or products only)
goes to the BM's exit meeting.
Every lost first visit gets a second look.
Everything you save is saved in your name.
Never work on someone else's login.
Every action has a real person behind it.
Gleuhr Guide — Counsellor (draft)

blocks.title: Page 5
blocks.text:
All appointments — the bookings that concern you.
Visit history — pick a date and see the visits closed that day (Mine or Whole clinic).
Revenue group
Opportunities — the cross-sell pipeline: what is overdue, stalling or not opened, and what
was won or lost.
My cross-sells — every cross-sell you raised yourself, open or closed.
Balances — every package in your book that still owes money. Lists: Due today · Due
tomorrow · Due in 7 days · Delayed · Needs a next step · Dropped.
Calls — every patient in your book who owes money, with her last call and her next step.
Decided claims — every payment you recorded by hand that the accounts desk has
already decided (verified or not), by whom and when. Read only.
My audit results — reviews of your visits and consult-only closes.
Safety nets group
Unclosed visits — earlier days' visits that were never closed.
No follow-up — your patients with no live follow-up and no visit booked.
Next appointments — only shows while someone needs one: patients brought over from
the old system who still have sessions left and no next visit. Book each one.
Relationships — patients nobody has contacted for a long time, most neglected first.
How do I…? · Today and the visit
1. How do I see who is checked in and waiting for me?
When you need this: start of the day, and every time you finish with a patient.
Steps:
1 . Open Today. It opens on Checked in.
2. Use the Patients filter for All, New, Ongoing or With balance.
3. Look at Waiting at reception — to check in: they are booked but reception has not
checked them in yet.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"No visit is in progress — a visit joins this list when the patient checks in." → nobody is
checked in yet.
A read that fails shows "Couldn't load …" with Retry. Never read an empty list as "no
patients" until it has loaded.
Gleuhr Guide — Counsellor (draft)

2. How do I open a new patient's visit to build her sale?
When you need this: a first-visit patient has seen the doctor.
Steps:
1 . On Today, find her row. It says first consult.
2. Press Build. The Build page opens with the Doctor's Plan on the left.
3. The tabs are Package, Single session and Products/OC.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"No visit today — a payment is sent from a checked-in visit." → she is not checked in.
Reception checks her in first.
"Couldn't load this visit — reload the page before sending a collection." → reload the
page.
Who to ask: the doctor, if the plan is empty; reception, if she is not checked in.
Search words: build, new patient, first consult, package banana, doctor plan, sale, naya
patient
[Screenshot to add: Build page · Package tab · prefilled from doctor's plan]
3. How do I build a package from the doctor's plan?
When you need this: she agrees to a course of treatment.
Steps:
1 . On Build, open the Package tab. It is "prefilled from the doctor's plan".
2. Check the Package name, the treatments and Sessions for each. Use + treatment to
add a line.
3. Type the Package price.
4. In Planned schedule, set each Step and its Amount. Step 1 must meet the clinic's first-
visit minimum.
5. When it says " ✓  Schedule matches the total", press Send.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Step 1 must collect at least ₹ … — …% of ₹ … (now ₹ …)" → raise step 1.

When you need this: the build is ready and she is going to pay.
Steps:
1 . Press Send (or Send → reception on a collection).
2. You see "Sent to reception. The treatment is created when reception collects the
payment — not before."

5. How do I restage a build that reception sent back?
When you need this: reception could not collect what you built (she paid a different
amount, or something was wrong).
Steps:
1 . Open her Build page. The sent build shows The desk's note: with reception's reason.
2. Press ↺  Restage this build. The card fills again with what you sent.
3. Fix it and press Send again.

When you need this: she wants one session only.
Steps:
1 . On Build, open Single session.
2. Pick the service, then press Send.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Sent to reception. The session is created when reception collects the payment — not

7. How do I sell products on the visit?
When you need this: she buys home-care products during her visit.
Steps:
1 . On Build, open Products/OC (or on an ongoing patient's visit page, Products).
2. Add each product under Paid products. Free items go under Complimentary.
3. Press Send. Reception collects.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Pick a product first." → add a product.
"Send complimentary → the desk (nothing to collect)" → only free products: reception
hands them over, nothing to pay.
Who to ask: reception for stock questions.
Search words: products, serum, sunscreen, cream, home care, product bechna, OC,
complimentary, free product
How do I…? · Tokens, money on file and ongoing patients
8. How do I take a token?
When you need this: she wants to hold a quoted price and pay a little now, and buy later.
Steps:
1 . On her visit, press Take a token.
2. Pick Package or Single session, then the treatments.
3. Type Quoted ₹ (what you quoted her today) and Token ₹ (what she pays now).
4. Add a note if needed. Press Save. Reception collects the token.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"A token at or above the quote is a sale, not a token — build the package instead."
"A token is taken on a checked-in visit." → she must be checked in.
A token creates no package and no balance. The visit closes as Token payment
received.
Who to ask: reception collects the money.

9. How do I send a token payment link (she is not in the clinic)?
When you need this: she wants to pay a token from home.
Steps:
1 . Open her record. In the tokens section press Take token.
2. Fill the same form (treatments, Quoted ₹, Token ₹). Press Create link.
3. Copy the link and send it to her yourself.
4. When she pays, the token appears on her record by itself.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Unpaid, it reads Waiting for her to pay. Nothing is money until she pays.
An expired link → press New link.
Who to ask: accounts, if she says she paid and it does not show.
Search words: token link, payment link, razorpay, link bhejna, online token, remote token
10. How do I use a token she already paid?
When you need this: she has a token held and now buys the package.
Steps:
1 . Build the package and send it.
2. On the collection, use Apply to … ("apply it to what you just built").
3. Reception sees a token credit line and collects only the rest.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Nothing is left of this token." → it is used up.
"Nothing is usable now — …, already on a step reception has not collected yet." → wait
for reception.
Who to ask: reception.
Search words: use token, apply token, token adjust, token kaatna, deduct token
11. How do I change what a token is for?
When you need this: she paid a token for one treatment and now wants another.
Steps:
1 . On her record, open the tokens section and press She wants something else.
2. Answer What is she buying instead?, type the New quote ₹, and Why did it change?

"The new quote is at or below the token — a token at the quote is a sale, not a token."

12. How do I apply an advance or store credit to a payment?
When you need this: she has money on file (an advance, or credit) and wants to use it.
Steps:
1 . On the collection (Build page or visit page), find Available credit.
2. Pick the credit and type How much of it to put on this collection.
3. Send. Reception collects only the rest.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"You've picked available credit but not said how much — type an amount, or clear the
pick."
"You've typed an amount of available credit but not picked which credit it comes from."
Credit is never used by itself. Closing a visit never uses it. A part-used advance keeps
the rest for later.
Who to ask: accounts, if an advance you expect is not listed (it may not be verified yet).
Search words: advance, credit, money on file, store credit, adjust advance, pehle diya,
wallet, balance credit
13. How do I collect an instalment from an ongoing patient?
When you need this: a patient with a package comes for her visit and pays the next step.
Steps:
1 . On Today, press Open on her row. Her visit page opens.
2. Press Collect installment.
3. Check This payment is for (the package) and the Amount now.
4. Send. Reception collects and gives the receipt.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"An amount above is more than its treatment still owes — bring it down to send."

15. How do I add a sale after I closed today's visit?
When you need this: you closed the visit and she then buys something, or pays a balance.
Steps:
1 . On Today, find the closed row and press Add a sale.
2. Add the sale on her visit page and send it.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
The sale is marked "Added after close".
"A sale cannot be added to this visit now." → the day may be locked. Ask your BM.
Only today's closed visits have this button.
Who to ask: your BM.
Search words: add sale, after close, baad mein kharida, extra sale, closed visit sale
How do I…? · Closing the visit
16. How do I close a visit?
When you need this: every visit, every day, before she leaves or soon after.
Steps:
1 . Press Close visit ✓ (on the Build page or the visit page).
2. The Visit outcome is worked out for you from what happened.
3. Answer every follow-up due today, or add the next follow-up (Follow-up reason and
Follow-up date).
4. Answer any question the gate asks.
5. Press the close button. "Are you sure you want to close this visit?" — confirm.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Cannot close a visit without adding a next follow-up." → add one.
"Give every follow-up due today a disposition."
"Client is still under treatment." — "The visit was not closed. Close it after the therapist
saves the session log."
"This visit is from an earlier day — type the late-close reason."
Saving locks your close. It cannot be edited afterwards.
Who to ask: your BM.
Search words: close visit, visit band karna, close gate, follow-up, close karo, visit done,
lock

17. How do I close a visit when she bought a package and gets treatment today?
When you need this: a first-visit patient buys a package and the doctor saw her.
Steps:
1 . Press Close visit ✓.
2. Answer When does she take the treatment? — Treatment today or Treatment later.
3. Treatment today: "The visit goes to the doctor for the sign-off and the session; her
waiting time counts from your close."
4. Treatment later: "Your close finishes today's visit and takes her off the doctor's list."
5. Add the follow-up and save.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
After Treatment today you see "Your close is recorded — …". The visit stays open. The
doctor closes it after the treatment.
On Today her row shows that your part is done.
Who to ask: the doctor.
Search words: treatment today, treatment later, aaj treatment, baad mein treatment, two
closes, doctor close
Screenshot: [Screenshot to add: Close visit ✓  · When does she take the treatment?]
18. How do I close a ﬁrst consult where she bought nothing?
When you need this: a new patient saw the doctor and did not buy a treatment.
Steps:
1 . On Build, in Products/OC, use Nothing to convert? and pick the reason.
2. Press Close visit ✓. The outcome is Consult only.
3. Write the Concern and Why no conversion?
4. Answer Did the BM meet the patient? — Yes or No.
5. If an appointment agent booked her: answer Did you talk to the appointment agent
who booked this visit?
6. Add the next follow-up and save.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"This is the patient's first consult — the visit that could have converted. It closes only
with the reason why."
"Pick why this visit didn't convert."

19. How do I close a visit where she only bought products?
When you need this: she bought products and nothing else.

1 . Press Close visit ✓. The outcome is Product only.

3. A new patient: also give the concern and answer the BM question, as for a consult-only

What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Add her follow-up — an ongoing patient's product-only visit never closes without one."

20. How do I close a visit when nothing happened (ongoing patient)?
When you need this: an ongoing patient came, nothing was built or sold, no session.
Steps:
1 . Press Close visit ✓. The outcome is Only visit - no activity done.
2. Add the next follow-up (or answer the ones due). Save.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Add the next follow-up — a visit never closes without
one."
Who to ask: your BM.
Search words: only visit, no activity, kuch nahi hua, just came, check-up visit

When you need this: you took a token on this visit.

22. How do I close an old visit from an earlier day?
When you need this: a visit from an earlier day was never closed.
Steps:
1 . Open Unclosed visits (or the Unclosed (incl. unassigned) tab on Today).
2. Press Open visit and then Close visit ✓.
3. Type the late-close reason. Add the follow-up. Save.
4. A patient who never came: Close as no-show… (only after the evening sweep has
proposed it).
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"This visit is from an earlier day — type the late-close reason."
"End of Day has not proposed this one as a no-show yet, so there is nothing to confirm.
It will appear after tonight's sweep."
Who to ask: your BM.
Search words: unclosed, old visit, purani visit, late close, pending close, no-show, never
came
23. Why can't I close the visit yet?
When you need this: the close button is grey or the close is refused.
Steps:
1 . Read the line under the button. It names what is missing.
2. Fix that one thing, then press again.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
Money still waiting at reception → reception must collect (or send it back) first.

How do I…? · Calls and follow-ups
24. How do I work my follow-up calls?
When you need this: every day, between patients.
Steps:
1 . Open Follow-ups. It opens on Today's list → Follow-up calls.
2. Press a patient to open her call.
3. Call her. On each open follow-up card, pick an outcome — or Skip if it did not come up.
4. For a live outcome, pick the Next follow-up date (Tomorrow, 2 days, 4 days, 1 week, or
a date).
5. Press Save call →.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Set an outcome (or Skip) for each reason — and leave a next step — to save the call."
"No follow-up remains — add a follow-up or hard-close before saving."
After saving, the list says Updating… for a moment while it reloads. Your row reads
"Saved · updating…".
Who to ask: your BM.
Search words: follow-up, call, calling, call list, phone karna, aaj ki calls, save call, next date

What the ratings mean (approved by the founder, 27 Oct):
5 — did it alone, right first time, at normal desk speed.
4 — did it alone and right, but slower, or caught and fixed your own small slip.
3 — needed one prompt from the BM, or made one mistake the BM had to point out.
2 — needed several prompts, or made a mistake the BM had to fix.
1 — could not do it.
In every task your BM looks at five things: the steps (right order, nothing skipped), the
screen (right page and buttons, refusals read and acted on), the rules (the right person
decides, nothing overwritten, a next step every time), the patient (clear, polite, handed to
the right colleague) and the pace (normal desk speed). No single mistake fails a task on
its own; it lowers that task's rating.

Q2. Who picks the visit outcome?
a) You choose from a list · b) The gate works it out from what happened ✓  · c) The BM
Why: the outcome follows the facts of the visit.
Q3. Can you edit a visit after you close it?
a) Yes, any time · b) No — saving locks it ✓  · c) Only the same day
Why: a closed visit is locked; a new sale is added with Add a sale.
Lesson 7 · Treatment today or later; first consults
A package on a first visit asks Treatment today or Treatment later. A first consult with no
sale asks why, and the BM question. Cards 17, 18.
Q1. You pick Treatment today. Who closes the visit in the end?
a) You · b) The doctor, after the treatment ✓  · c) Reception
Why: your close is the sales close; the doctor's close comes after treatment.
Q2. A new patient bought nothing. What must you give?
a) The concern and why she didn't convert ✓  · b) Nothing · c) A ticket
Why: a first consult closes only with the reason.
Q3. Does the doctor's gate have a close-patient button?
a) Yes · b) No ✓
Why: only a counsellor hard-closes.
Lesson 8 · Follow-up calls
Every call ends in a next date or a hard-close. Cards 24–30.
Q1. She doesn't answer. When does she come back on your list?
a) Tomorrow, unless you change it ✓  · b) Never · c) In a month
Why: a no-answer comes back on its date.
Q2. How many no-answers in a row move her to Unreachable?
a) 1 · b) 2 · c) 3 ✓
Why: three misses in a row, then a person decides.
Q3. Can you save a call that leaves no next step?
a) Yes · b) No — add a follow-up or hard-close ✓

Why: every call ends in a next step or an explicit close.
Lesson 9 · Balances and links
Balance follow-ups are made by the system. Links are copied and sent by you. Cards 31–
35.
Q1. Who creates a balance follow-up?
a) The system, automatically ✓  · b) You, by hand · c) Accounts
Why: money owed never depends on memory.
Q2. A link is out and she wants to pay by card at the desk. First step?
a) Collect again by card · b) Cancel link & collect here ✓  · c) Ignore the link
Why: cancelling first prevents paying twice.
Q3. A manual payment you recorded counts towards the balance when…
a) You save it · b) Accounts verifies it ✓  · c) The BM approves it
Why: accounts checks it against the bank first.
Lesson 10 · Changes that need approval
Your own patient's booking: change it at once. Anyone else's: ask the BM. A package price:
the Sales Head. Cards 36, 37, 39.
Q1. Who approves a change to a package's amount?
a) The BM · b) The Sales Head ✓  · c) Nobody
Why: price changes after sale go to the Sales Head.
Q2. Moving another counsellor's patient's booking needs…
a) Nothing · b) Request a change → the BM approves ✓  · c) The doctor
Why: only your own patient's booking changes at once.
Q3. A wrong amount in money history is fixed by…
a) Editing the old line · b) A new correcting entry; the old one stays ✓  · c) Deleting the
payment
Why: money history is never edited.
Lesson 11 · Huddle and the day end
Morning Huddle: one decision per patient per day. Close my day refuses while anything
blocking is open. Cards 45, 46.

Q1. How many huddle decisions per patient per day?
a) One ✓  · b) As many as you like
Why: a change is tomorrow's decision.
Q2. Which stops your day from closing?
a) A visit not closed ✓  · b) An open ticket · c) A request waiting on the BM
Why: unclosed visits block; tickets and requests only warn.
Q3. Until when can you reopen a closed day?
a) Any time · b) The same day, until midnight ✓  · c) Never
Why: after midnight, ask your BM.
Ready for sign-off — what your BM will ask you to show
When you have passed every lesson, your BM watches you do these on the real desk, with
real patients. Then your BM signs you off as Trained. Until then your desk shows In
training, but nothing is blocked. (The Trained sign-off and the In training badge are coming
with the Guide; they are not in the app yet.)
1 . Build a package from the doctor's plan with a correct payment plan, and send it to
reception.
What a 5 looks like: starts from the doctor's plan on Build (changes only what the
patient asked for); sets a payment plan whose first step meets the clinic's first-visit
share and that matches the total; presses Send and tells the patient to go to reception.
2. Close a new patient's visit — a package close, or a consult-only close with the BM
questions answered.
What a 5 looks like: reads the outcome the gate works out (never forces one); answers
every follow-up due and seeds the next step; for a package, picks Treatment today or
Treatment later; for consult-only, gives the reason and answers the BM questions
honestly.
3. Work three follow-up calls: one reached with a next date, one no-answer, and one with
a new follow-up added.
What a 5 looks like: gives every follow-up an outcome — a next date for the reached
call, a try-again date for the no-answer; adds the new follow-up in the same call; saves
only when every follow-up has a next step, and never hard-closes to clear a list.
4. Apply a token or money on file to a payment step, or collect an instalment from an
ongoing patient.
What a 5 looks like: applies the money on file to the right package and never more than
is left on it; sends the collection to reception with a split that matches the amount; tells
the patient the balance that will remain.

What a 5 looks like: closes every visit of the day through Close visit ✓; finishes or
moves every call due today; reads each item on Close my day and clears it with its own
button before closing.
